A goal is satisfied only when every action required by that goal has been committed to. A MENU presents two mutually exclusive binding offers: the partner may choose either offered bundle or reject both; only the chosen bundle binds. PASS or a resolved offer consumes one scheduled proposer turn.
Partner preferences persist. Public catalogues describe possible types. Use the declared partner mechanism and distinguish public type-independent setup from subsequent evidence. Consider remaining opportunities, not only current satisfaction.
